findings.motion: House floor amendment A6 (S824-ATC-203) offered by Representative Warren, second reading; failed 17-89
findings.note: Amendment text: a voter without photo ID who signs the affidavit would cast a provisional ballot that includes date of birth and the last four digits of the Social Security number or driver license number, and the county board would count it unless the declaration was false or nonsensical, the data was missing, or registration could not be confirmed. The vote page (https://www.ncleg.gov/Legislation/Votes/RollCallVoteTranscript/2017/H/1316) lists Warren among the 17 ayes.
subjects: provisional ballot for a voter without ID

findings.motion: House floor amendment A5 (S824-ATC-204) offered by Representative Warren, second reading; adopted 68-39
findings.note: Amendment text: colleges that issue student ID cards under the bill would hand students State Board of Elections material on voting ID rules, absentee, early and election-day voting, provisional ballots and the free voter photo ID card; the State Board would post the same information on its website. The vote page (https://www.ncleg.gov/Legislation/Votes/RollCallVoteTranscript/2017/H/1315) lists the Warren amendment as adopted.

subjects: no-ID voter, affidavit and provisional ballot
